confirmed.finding: Schema2 frozen expected/span/source values are comparison-only. Common stdlib reauthenticate validates current canonical origin raw hash/size, exact direct subject/kind, lexical span/text/truncation before creating CAMI state or importing ProductMemory. RememberInput receives only kind/query/context/request_id; core derives payload from authenticated context/CAS. Adapter checks context certificate and complete normalized server-derived payload afterward.

Both arms use the same reauthenticated catalog and shared retrieval/ranking/original-record budget. Static preparation imports no CAMI and labels origin literal assertions unchecked_current. CAMI available literals use validated_literal_source; unavailable entries yield summaries without expected/historical text or result replacement. Complete module source hashes are rechecked at end of preparation.

Schema2 explicitly supports only source_excerpt_equals with exact field sets and portable origin_source. Manual notes/schema1 remain a separate path; no automatic conversion or caller expected field reaches registration. Only origin_source.index is removed during core payload comparison; expected text/truncated, portable source path/hash/size and origin span remain.

Independent full static lookup response bytes match preserved batch-v2 backend for authored schema1 manual note containing Unicode/header-like prose. Producer27 unit controls including schema1 golden pass. Common TOOL description intentionally changes in new version, so old-v3 agent byte equivalence is not claimed.

Generator uses stdlib-only direct syntactic enumeration, deterministic selectors/order/IDs, explicit schema2, regular/size/path controls and lexical physical @ span through definition end. It does not execute source or inspect outcomes. It is not a production binding/eligibility oracle: all frozen subjects must pass CAMI preflight or preparation fails, with no replacement/subset heuristic.

Default remains full. Compact projection retains new expected.text/truncated/origin_source/origin_span inside payload; top provenance pruning and unkeyed audit receipts have the previously reviewed pre-scrub trust boundary. Same projection/budget across arms.

limitations_not_blockers: This independent review did not rerun the producer's seven actual ProductMemory authored integration groups; their evidence manifest/code are pinned separately. No additional ProductMemory/database execution was needed for the bounded independent controls.

Static syntax enumeration can include subjects production regards as ambiguous/unavailable or ignored. Correctness requires fail-closed all-record CAMI preflight on the frozen cohort, not silently choosing a favorable subset.
Literal prefix availability is not full-body/behavior/API equivalence and says nothing about effects of surrounding globals/classes/imports.
No token, wall, CPU, quality or billing benefit established. Common reauthentication, registration, refresh, final reads and larger compact audit storage must be charged in any new frozen study.
Read_source uses ordinary regular-file checks and final rechecks in a trusted isolated preparation lifecycle; it is not a new OS namespace/security boundary.
Failures retain partial construction metrics/state in their new isolated namespace; controller must not reuse failed preparation as a valid binding.
